relations.subject: Heinrich Meinhard
relations.evidence: Ph.D. 1928 Bonn under Kirfel, but then turned to anthropology.

relations.subject: Heinrich Meinhard
relations.evidence: Curator of Indian civilisation in Berlin Ethnographic Museum. To save his Jewish wife he escaped 1937 to the U.K.

relations.subject: Heinrich Meinhard
relations.evidence: worked in Pitt Rivers Museum in Oxford in 1938-47 cataloguing ethnographic collections.

relations.subject: Heinrich Meinhard
relations.evidence: From 1950 Reader of Anthropology at Durham University, until retirement.
